protocol.split_rule: unique inputs ordered by the SHA-256 of their RFC 8785 canonical JSON; the first floor(n/2) are calibration, the rest held-out

sweep.rule: one shared threshold k/20 for every required output and label; the lowest k whose calibration agreement point estimate reaches the target with at least one accepted row; none: defer-all
